title: payment.failed
description: A payment attempt was declined. The opposite fact to payment.completed, and deliberately a separate event rather than a flag on it: a consumer subscribed to 'money arrived' must never be handed 'money did not arrive'. Nothing was granted and nothing is clawed back — a declined charge credited nothing — so this fact exists to be told to the payer.

amount_cents.description: The amount that was attempted, not taken.

invoice_id.description: Provider invoice this attempt belongs to. Present for subscription renewals. Consumers deduplicating repeated attempts on one invoice key on this.

payment_intent_id.description: Provider payment intent, for a failure outside the invoice flow (a one-off purchase). Present when invoice_id is not.

plan.description: Plan slug, when the failed attempt was a subscription renewal.

decline_reason.description: What the provider said: its human-readable seller message when it sent one, otherwise its decline code. Never rendered at a customer verbatim without translation — see stapel_billing.notifications._humanise_decline.

invoice_url.description: Provider-hosted invoice, when the payload carried one.

created_at.description: When the attempt failed, stamped at webhook reconciliation (within seconds of the attempt). Required: a consumer that writes to a human about money must be able to tell how long ago it happened, or a replayed outbox row mails a notice about a card that was fixed weeks ago.
